第970章老谋深算的绯
仅是当天傍晚时分，帝城之内便是流言四起。
“听说了没，帝子鹤无双的储君位置被废了......”
“帝宫之内公示，恐怕此事是真的。”
“莫非未来帝皇的位置会是一位女帝？”
“女帝又如何，女帝不是更惹人遐想？”
“那你也得敢想才是，而且不止如此，帝皇更是将四座王城交给帝子打理，如此恩宠，只怕真的是未来储君了......”
而此时此刻，东北方幽夜王城幽夜帝宫之内，有三人正在一间殿内议事。
一个幽王在那站着，他还以为今日绯会担保他上位，没想到转头就传出绯建议王座之子子承父位，这可让他急的团团转！
而他在回来之后，本打算自闭一段时间缓一缓，却突然被绯喊来见凌霄。
幽王的内心已经有些崩溃了。
你都把王座位置的人选推举上去了，我都没位置了还喊我来做什么，何况你们之间的对话，我也插不上嘴啊？
而此刻，的确是凌霄与鹤无双在谈话，幽王是连个座的位置都没有。
“先前大殿之上那番话，是你自己想的，还是其他人教给你的？”
绯轻笑着道：“自是与大帝合作之后，耳濡目染，发自心中所言，哪里会有什么人教我呢？”
凌霄心里忍不住翻白眼，那要不是那个孟通天教你这么办的你会说个鬼，还从我这里耳濡目染上了，更确切的是被楚宁耳濡目染了吧？
但看破不说破么，他还是给出了赞许。
“此举一出，帝皇直接贬鹤无双至西北从军，你顺势得四座王城支持，加之你推举王座为他们争利，如今棋盘总算是与鹤无双分庭抗礼了。”
说的是如今，绯有了五座王城的支持，能运营的也有五座王城，幽夜王城凌霄是不可能亲自去管的，如今既然绯来了，就全盘交给他，再加上其他几座还有这段时间吸收的势力，已经不俗了。
党争就是这样，有人看到了利益，立马就跟上来了，尤其是鹤无双如今麻烦这么大的情况下，连位置都废了，绯要是不趁机弄点什么，那就是蠢，没必要共事。

而如今的情况，超乎凌霄预料，他这段时候和绯都没有任何交流，只是恢复自身本源，但绯偏偏在外界拿出这份完美答卷，也足可见的其幕后大夏国师手笔多大，两面布局。
然而听到这话，绯不免有了疑惑：“如今才只是分庭抗礼么？可鹤无双已经被废储君位置，甚至什么都没了被贬去充军啊？”
看到的就是这样，储君的位置没了，统领帝宫的权力没了，回到了王孙手中，什么待遇什么资源也全都没了。
那如今不是她赢了？
幽王傻了吧唧地在一旁站着，满脑子都是自己王座没了的事情，所以王座没了让我来这做什么？
也没听出绯这话，其实已经是明显露怯，完全可以确定绯简直什么都不懂，纯纯后面有人指挥！
凌霄显然没招了，无奈道：“那是鹤无双，古界第一天骄，论资格，十个你都比不上他。”
绯满头问号，更不懂了，啥？
凌霄干脆说的明白点：“如果他真没资格，你觉得他还能活着么？”
“储君的位置，涉及未来黑暗古皇的位置，但有争端，定动摇整个古界，其实你在踏上这条路上的时候就几乎要死了，一旦黑暗古皇去问责，随便一个罪名便能直接处死你，抹杀你一切本源，你以为你活着是因为什么？”
绯没学过这个，一脸真诚的问：“莫非是父亲想看看我是不是比兄长更合适？”

Chapter 970 The scheming Fei
In the evening of that day alone, rumors were spreading throughout the Imperial City.
"Have you heard that the crown prince position of the emperor He Wushuang has been abolished..."
"It has been announced in the imperial palace that this matter is probably true."
"Could it be that the future emperor's position will be a female emperor?"
"So what about the empress? Isn't the empress more fascinating?"
"Then you have to dare to think about it, and not only that, the emperor also handed over four royal cities to the emperor to take care of. With such favor, I am afraid that he will really be the future prince..."
At this moment, in the Youye Emperor's Palace in Youye King City in the northeast, three people were discussing matters in a hall.
A King You was standing there. He thought that Fei would guarantee him the throne today. Unexpectedly, he turned around and heard that Fei suggested that the son of the throne should inherit the throne from his father. This made him anxious!
After he came back, he planned to stay in isolation for a while, but he was suddenly called to see Ling Xiao by Fei.
King You's heart was already a little broken.
You have already recommended candidates for the throne. Why are you asking me to come when I don’t have a position? Besides, I can’t get involved in the conversation between you?
But at this moment, it was indeed Ling Xiao and He Wushuang talking, and King You didn't even have a seat.
"Did you think of those words in the main hall earlier, or were they taught to you by others?"
Fei chuckled and said: "Since I cooperated with the emperor, I have been influenced by what I heard and what I said from my heart. Where can I find anyone to teach me?"
Ling Xiao couldn't help but roll his eyes in his heart. If Meng Tongtian hadn't taught you to do this, you would have said something stupid. You also got it from me. To be more precise, you got it from Chu Ning, right?
But if he saw through it, he still gave it his approval.
"As soon as this move came out, the emperor directly demoted He Wushuang to join the army in the northwest. You took advantage of the situation and gained the support of the four royal cities. In addition, you promoted the throne to fight for their interests. Now the chessboard can finally compete with He Wushuang."
What I'm talking about is that now, Fei has the support of five royal cities, and there are five royal cities that can be operated. It is impossible for Ling Xiao to manage Youye Royal City personally. Now that Fei is here, it is all handed over to him, plus the other ones and the forces they have absorbed during this period, it is already impressive.
Party struggle is like this. Some people see the benefits and immediately follow him. Especially when He Wushuang is in such big trouble now that he has lost his position. If Fei doesn't take the opportunity to do something, then he is stupid and there is no need to work together.
The current situation is beyond Ling Xiao's expectation. He has not had any communication with Fei during this period, and has only returned to his true nature. However, Fei has come up with such a perfect answer to the outside world, which shows how powerful the Daxia Guoshi is behind the scenes and has two sides.
However, after hearing this, Fei couldn't help but have doubts: "Is it just a matter of fighting against each other now? But He Wushuang has been deposed as the heir apparent, and has even lost everything and been demoted to the army?"
This is what I see. The position of the crown prince is gone, the power to command the imperial palace is gone, it has returned to the hands of the prince and grandson, and all the benefits and resources are gone.
So doesn't she win now?
King You stood aside in a daze, his mind full of the fact that his throne was gone, so what should I do here if the throne is gone?
I didn't hear what Fei said. In fact, it was obvious that Fei was timid. It was absolutely certain that Fei didn't understand anything, and there was someone directing Chunchun from behind!
Ling Xiao obviously had no choice but to say helplessly: "That's He Wushuang, the number one genius in the ancient world. In terms of qualifications, even ten of you can't compare to him."
Fei's head is full of questions, and she doesn't even understand, what?
Ling Xiao simply said it more clearly: "If he is really not qualified, do you think he can still be alive?"
"The position of the Crown Prince involves the position of the future Dark Ancient Emperor, but if there is a dispute, it will definitely shake the entire ancient world. In fact, you almost died when you set out on this road. Once the Dark Ancient Emperor goes to hold you accountable, you can be directly executed for any crime and everything about you will be wiped out.Origin, why do you think you are alive? "
Fei had never learned this before and asked sincerely: "Could it be that my father wants to see if I am more suitable than my brother? "
